Velkoz|sup.identity: Artillery mage. Organic Deconstruction (passive): his abilities apply stacks; at 3 stacks, the target takes a burst of true damage. Plasma Fission (Q) fires a projectile that slows and splits in two when it hits an enemy or is recast, Void Rift (W) opens a rift that damages, then explodes after a short delay, Tectonic Disruption (E) knocks up enemies in an area, and Life Form Disintegration Ray (R) channels for 2.5 seconds a ray that follows the cursor (true damage on targets marked by his passive).
Velkoz|sup.playstyle: Poke and damage support: he harasses from very long range with W and Q, then finishes fights with his ray. He dominates melee supports and slow mages (Swain, Brand, Camille, Pantheon), but fears hooks and engages (Blitzcrank). No mobility.
Velkoz|sup.early_game: Poke with Void Rift (W) on your opponent when they come to last hit. Keep Tectonic Disruption (E) for an enemy engage or a kill. Three abilities hitting the same target trigger your passive explosion: W, then Q, then E.
Velkoz|sup.level_1: Plasma Fission (Q) first. After that, max Q first.
Velkoz|sup.level_2: Void Rift (W) or Tectonic Disruption (E). W to poke, E for safety against an engage support.
Velkoz|sup.level_3: The missing ability. Combo: E (knock-up) → W → Q → passive explosion.
Velkoz|sup.level_6: Life Form Disintegration Ray: a channeled ray that follows your cursor. Cast it after an E or on a rooted target; you're immobile while channeling.
power_spikes: Level 6: ray at the end of your combo.
First completed item: very punishing poke.
Teamfights: ray on a grouped team.
Velkoz|sup.lane_plan: Poke with W and Q, keep E for defense and play for kills with your ADC. Stay in the bot lane until level 5: since patch 26.16, your minion gold and XP are cut by a third elsewhere. The support role quest then makes your Control Wards cheaper (40 gold, two stored).
Velkoz|sup.trading: Basic trade: W. All-in: E → W → Q → R. Defense: E on the enemy engage. Against Blitzcrank, stay behind minions at all times.
threats: Poppy: she stops your ray by charging you.
Engages and assassins: you have no mobility.
mistakes: Casting the ray too close to enemies.
Missing E and no longer being able to defend yourself.
Standing in the open against a hook.

matchup_notes.Thresh: Stay behind minions and E under him if he engages.
matchup_notes.Lulu: Poke trades: your W range is longer.
matchup_notes.Nautilus: E when he arrives with his anchor.
matchup_notes.Swain: He has to get close: poke him from range.
matchup_notes.Blitzcrank: A hook on you is often fatal: stay behind your minions.

Velkoz|sup.mid_game: Poke before objectives, place Control Wards and stay with your team.
Velkoz|sup.late_game: Stay far behind your frontline, poke with W and Q, E on divers, then ray on the enemy group.
Velkoz|sup.ahead: Poke harder and force grouped fights.
Velkoz|sup.behind: Poke safely from range and keep E to protect your ADC.
Velkoz|sup.win_condition: To win this game, you want to wear down the enemy team with your poke and finish fights with your ray.
Velkoz|sup.final_tip: Three abilities on the same target trigger your passive explosion: chain E, W and Q on the same enemy.
